title: Disagreeing and Contradicting
summary: Expressing disagreement, uncertainty, and alternative views.
whyItMatters: Constructive disagreement identifies the exact point at issue, gives a reason, and leaves space for clarification or an alternative.

mentalModel.title: Target the statement
mentalModel.content: Repeat or summarize the point you disagree with instead of rejecting the whole conversation.

mentalModel.title: Disagreement has degrees
mentalModel.content: Choose doubt, partial disagreement, clear contradiction, or an alternative according to the situation.

ruleBlocks.title: Check the claim first
ruleBlocks.content: Use Meinst du, dass or Habe ich richtig verstanden, dass before responding.

ruleBlocks.title: Mark the strength
ruleBlocks.content: Use Ich bin nicht sicher, Ich sehe das etwas anders, or Das stimmt so nicht.

ruleBlocks.title: Give a reason or counterexample
ruleBlocks.content: Support the alternative view with one relevant fact, experience, or consequence.

tables.title: Disagreement Toolkit
rows: Da bin ich nicht ganz sicher.

examples.de: Ich bin nicht sicher, ob diese Aktion wirklich weniger Müll produziert.
examples.en: I am not sure whether this campaign really produces less waste.

examples.de: In diesem Punkt hast du recht, aber die Kosten sind noch unklar.
examples.en: You are right on this point, but the costs are still unclear.

examples.de: Das sehe ich anders, weil viele Menschen kein Auto haben.
examples.en: I see that differently because many people do not have a car.

commonMistakes.correct: Name the claim and explain why you question it.
commonMistakes.reason: Personal dismissal does not advance the discussion.

commonMistakes.wrong: Disagree before checking what was meant.

comparisons.summary: Sustainability projects create realistic choices and tradeoffs.
Relative clauses identify the proposal, person, or object under discussion.
